{{Top|leg}}
'''Tekka nuts''' were a kind of [[Nut/Legends|nut]]. Like most nuts, they were consumed unshelled. Tekka nuts were available in the kitchen of [[Darkside (space station)|Darkside]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], although they were out of season at that point.
